faculty.name: 康锐
faculty.role: 中方主任 / 教授 / 博士生导师

sections.bio: 康锐，北京航空航天大学教授、博士生导师，2023年9月起兼任杭州市北京航空航天大学国际创新学院智慧民航科创中心首席科学家。长期从事可靠性理论与应用研究，创立确信可靠性理论。
sections.research: 确信可靠性理论与应用、信息物理系统可靠性建模与仿真、可靠性系统工程方法论，以及面向复杂工程系统的可靠性分析、评价与优化。
sections.achievements: 曾担任国家重大基础研究项目首席科学家，现任中国指挥控制学会可靠性系统科学与工程专业委员会主任委员、中国MBSE联盟可靠性系统工程专业委员会主任委员。获国家科技进步二等奖2项、省部级科技进步一等奖3项、北京市高等教育教学成果二等奖2项，授权发明专利100余项，发表SCI论文100余篇。

sectionsEn.bio: Rui Kang is a Professor and Doctoral Supervisor at Beihang University. Since September 2023, he has also served as Chief Scientist of the Smart Civil Aviation Science and Technology Innovation Center at the Hangzhou International Innovation Institute of Beihang University. His long-term work focuses on reliability theory and applications, and he founded belief reliability theory.
sectionsEn.research: Belief reliability theory and applications, cyber-physical system reliability modeling and simulation, reliability systems engineering methodology, and reliability analysis, assessment, and optimization for complex engineering systems.
sectionsEn.achievements: He has served as Chief Scientist of a National Major Basic Research Program and currently chairs the Reliability System Science and Engineering Professional Committee of the Chinese Institute of Command and Control and the Reliability Systems Engineering Professional Committee of the China MBSE Alliance. His honors include two Second Prizes of the National Science and Technology Progress Award, three First Prizes of provincial and ministerial science and technology progress awards, and two Second Prizes of the Beijing Higher Education Teaching Achievement Award. He has received more than 100 authorized invention patents and published more than 100 SCI-indexed papers.

faculty.name: Enrico Zio
faculty.role: 意方主任 / 教授 / 博士生导师

sections.bio: Enrico Zio，意大利米兰理工大学能源系教授，同时任法国巴黎文理研究大学 Mines Paris-PSL 风险与危机研究中心教授。其教育背景涵盖米兰理工大学核工程、UCLA机械工程、MIT概率风险评估等方向。
sections.research: 复杂系统安全、可靠性与韧性，面向能源、关键基础设施等场景开展风险分析、可靠性评估与韧性工程研究，人工智能和演化算法在风险与可靠性分析中的应用。
sections.achievements: 发表国际期刊论文700余篇，出版著作10部，长期入选 Stanford 全球前2%科学家与 Clarivate 高被引科学家榜单。曾获 Humboldt Research Award、IEEE Fellow、International Society for Reliability and Safety Lifetime Achievement Award 等国际荣誉。

sectionsEn.bio: Enrico Zio is Full Professor at the Department of Energy of Politecnico di Milano and Full Professor at the Centre for Research on Risk and Crises at Mines Paris - PSL University. His education spans nuclear engineering at Politecnico di Milano, mechanical engineering at UCLA, and probabilistic risk assessment at MIT.
sectionsEn.research: Safety, reliability, and resilience of complex systems, risk analysis and resilience engineering for energy and critical infrastructure, and applications of artificial intelligence and evolutionary algorithms in risk and reliability analysis.
sectionsEn.achievements: He has authored more than 700 international journal papers and 10 books, and has been ranked among the Stanford Top 2% World Scientists and Clarivate Highly Cited Researchers. His honors include the Humboldt Research Award, IEEE Fellow, and the Lifetime Achievement Award from the International Society for Reliability and Safety.
